annotations.title: Check a tech pack is factory-ready

description: Use this tool to check whether a garment tech pack (JSON) is ready to send to a factory: missing fields, measurement chart checks (tolerances, how to measure, grading that grows with size, usual points for its family), fibre composition summing to 100 % with EU 1007/2011 fibre names, care label, and the Digital Product Passport fields it already covers. Returns a score and a list of fixes. From Cycle Studio; free and deterministic, no account needed.

family.description: Optional garment family to check its usual points of measure.

techpack.description: The tech pack with any keys: style_name, style_number, season, family/category, factory, composition, care, country_of_origin, fabric, weight, colourways, construction, trims, flats, measurements {sample_size, points: [{name, values: {size: cm}, tolerance, how_to_measure}]}.

name: validate_techpack
